correctness.rationale: Read RESULT.md and CHECK.py at assigned tree. Angular orthogonality gives two orthonormal monomial families in the stated unweighted radial measure; the binomial coefficient times the square root of two beta integrals simplifies exactly to Gamma(n+c)*sqrt(Gamma(A-1)Gamma(B-1))/(Gamma(c)*sqrt(Gamma(n+A)Gamma(n+B)). The input V_n and output U_n span the operator range/co-range; gamma ratios give exponent c-(A+B)/2 and bounded/compact/Schatten thresholds. The exact consecutive ratio (n+c)/sqrt((n+A)(n+B)) plus strict arithmetic-geometric mean proves ordered transition thresholds, ties and k(c)=(A-B)^2/(8(m-c))+O(1); strict monotone approach to the critical limit yields nonattainment and essential norm. Symmetric critical singular coefficients are all 1/(A-1), giving a scaled orthogonal projection. Independent SymPy algebra and 35-degree threshold scans over three independent weight pairs corroborated normalization and ordering; no finite scan establishes the infinite claim.
